packageRules.description: Flux owns deployment tags for first-party service images
Group container base and deployment image updates

Hold the web workspace root on cookie 0.7. The root manifest declares cookie only so the hoisted node_modules the SSR images ship carries the version SvelteKit needs: adapter-node leaves `cookie` external, the runtime image has just /app/build and /app/node_modules, and @sveltejs/kit imports { parse, serialize }, which cookie 2 removed in favour of parseCookie/stringifySetCookie. 0.7 is also the floor that fixes CVE-2024-47764 in the 0.6 line kit still asks for. The two Astro sites pin cookie 2 in their own manifests and get nested copies; only this entry is held.

Hold the web workspace's @opentelemetry/core override on 2.x. Every OpenTelemetry SDK, exporter and transformer package in web/bun.lock pins core 2.x, and core 3 needs @opentelemetry/api >=1.10 while the workspace runs 1.9; forcing 3 through the override would push it under all of them. Lift this when the SDK packages move to core 3.

Let k8s.io/kube-openapi and the kustomize modules follow k8s.io/apimachinery. Newer kube-openapi pseudo-versions (and kustomize 0.21.3, which requires one) build on structured-merge-diff/v7 while apimachinery v0.37 still uses v6, which breaks the clusterops build. Lift this when apimachinery moves to structured-merge-diff/v7.

Hold the console and the ui library on TypeScript 6. svelte-check refuses to run against TypeScript 7 unless both 6 and 7 are installed and --tsgo is passed, and that mode resolves .svelte imports to the ambient module declaration -- component props degrade to any and a string passed to a boolean prop goes unreported. Lift this when svelte-check supports 7 outside its experimental path.
